formula: It was not until + X + that + Y

formulas.formula: It was not until + X + that + Y

example: It was not until the final meeting that we understood the seriousness of the problem.
exampleZh: 直到最後一次會議，我們才明白問題的嚴重性。

examples.en: It was not until the final meeting that we understood the seriousness of the problem.
examples.zh: 直到最後一次會議，我們才明白問題的嚴重性。
examples.highlight: It was not until the final meeting that we understood the seriousness of the problem.

rules.zh: 在 It was not until X that Y 結構中，that 後面使用正常陳述句語序，即主語在前、動詞在後，不可加入 did 倒裝。Not until X + 助動詞 + 主語 + 主要動詞是另一個結構；兩者都能強調延誤的時間點，但語序不可混合。
rules.en: Use normal word order after “that” It was not until the final meeting that we understood the problem. It was not until the final meeting that did we understand the problem. The inversion belongs to a different structure: Not until the final meeting did we understand the problem. Compare: Not until X + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb Not until Friday did she reply. It was not until X that + subject + normal verb It was not until Friday that she replied.

rules.zh: 由「not...until」改寫成這個強調句時，that 子句通常改為肯定形式。原句的否定意思已由 not until 承擔，不可在 that 子句內再次加入否定。
rules.en: The that-clause usually becomes affirmative Source: She did not notice the mistake until Friday. Target answer: It was not until Friday that she noticed the mistake. It was not until Friday that she did not notice the mistake. The incorrect version means that she still failed to notice it on Friday.

rules.zh: 在 It was not until X that Y 結構中，X 與 that 子句之間不可加逗號；但整句前面的引導短語仍可按一般規則使用逗號。
rules.en: Do not place a comma before “that” It was not until midnight that they arrived. It was not until midnight, that they arrived. An introductory phrase may have a comma: In the end, it was not until midnight that they arrived.

rules.zh: 改寫時必須保留原句準確的時間關係。若原句表示晚飯後才致電，X 部分便要保留 after dinner；省去 after 會誤變成直到晚飯時間才致電。
rules.en: Preserve the exact time relationship. Source: He called me only after dinner. Answer: It was not until after dinner that he called me. Do not remove after, because that would change the meaning to ‘not until dinner’.

rules.zh: 在這個句式中，X 部分標示事情延遲至哪一刻才發生，並不表示因果或目的。例如 alarm sounded 只指出家人發現火警的時間，不代表警報造成火警。
rules.en: X marks the delayed point, not the cause or purpose It was not until the alarm sounded that the family noticed the fire. This sentence identifies the moment when they first noticed the fire. It does not necessarily say that the alarm caused the fire or that anyone sounded it for that purpose.

rules.zh: 在 Y 部分可按意思使用不同動詞形式，包括一般過去式、被動語態及情態動詞；X 部分也可使用過去完成式。X 或 Y 內部的時態和語態改變時，It was not until X that Y 的核心結構保持不變。
rules.en: Different verb forms may appear in Y Simple past It was not until Friday that she replied. Passive voice It was not until the next morning that the bicycle was found. Modal verb It was not until the clouds cleared that the rescuers could see the village. Past perfect inside X It was not until every parent had been contacted that the trip was cancelled. The target structure remains the same even when the grammar inside X or Y changes.

rules.zh: 本練習集中操練過去式 It was not until X that Y。現在式 It is not until X that Y 雖然合乎文法，但不是本組題目的目標形式。
rules.en: This exercise practises the past form The target in this exercise is: It was not until X that The following related present form is grammatically correct but is not the target of this exercise: It is not until next week that the course begins.

benefits.zh: 突出重要的轉捩點直到醫生解釋檢查結果，伊森才明白病情的嚴重性。
benefits.en: It emphasises an important turning point This structure tells the reader that X was the moment when the situation finally changed. It was not until the doctor explained the results that Ethan understood the seriousness of the condition. The reader’s attention is drawn to the doctor’s explanation as the key turning point.

benefits.zh: 這個句式把「較早仍未發生的事情」和「事情終於發生的時間點」放在同一句中，令先後次序一目了然。例如直到雨停孩子才外出，讀者可立即知道雨停前他們一直留在室內，不會誤解兩件事的時間關係。
benefits.en: It makes a timeline easier to understand The structure clearly separates: what had not happened earlier the point when it finally happened. It was not until the rain stopped that the children went outside. The reader can immediately understand that the children remained indoors before the rain stopped.

benefits.zh: 這個強調句能把普通的 did not...until... 改寫得更有力度，把讀者注意力集中在延誤終結或事情終於發生的時間點。
benefits.en: It adds emphasis to an ordinary “did not... until...” sentence Compare: The team did not score until the second half. It was not until the second half that the team scored. Both versions are correct. The second version gives greater attention to the second half and makes the delay sound more important.

benefits.zh: 這個句式能把背景事件與其後的發現、領悟、回應或結果連成一個有條理的句子，清楚交代兩者的時間關係。
benefits.en: It helps combine background and discovery This structure is useful when describing: a realisation a discovery a delayed response a problem that became clear a result that appeared later. The director did not discover the design error before production began. The director admitted that it was not until production had begun that the team discovered the design error. The second version presents the delayed discovery as one organised idea.

benefits.zh: 這個句式可增加句式變化，避免反覆使用 did not...until...、only after、only when、then 或 finally，同時保留相同的時間關係。
benefits.en: It gives you more sentence variety Instead of repeatedly using: did not... until... only after... only when... then finally you can use it was not until... that... to express the same time relationship in a different way.

benefits.zh: 這個句式適合用於故事、報告、簡報和正式解釋，尤其可交代某人終於明白事情、問題被發現、決定作出或證據出現的時間。
benefits.en: It is useful in stories, reports and formal explanations The structure is particularly useful when explaining when: someone finally understood something a problem was discovered a decision was made evidence became available a system began to work the effects of a change became clear. It can therefore be used naturally in narratives, essays, reports, presentations and workplace communication.
